title: A Doughnut-Like Eu30 Catalyst for CO2 Photoreduction with Turnover Numbers Over Ten Million

synthesis.procedure: 1,3,4-Thiadiazole-2,5-diamine (116 mg, 0.2 mmol), 8-hydroxyquinoline-2-carbaldehyde (19 mg, 0.1 mmol), Eu(NO3)3·6H2O (68 mg, 0.2 mmol), and triethylamine (40 μL) were added to 2 mL of methanol/water (2:1 by volume) in a Pyrex tube. The sealed tube was heated at 80 °C for 72 h. Yellow crystals were obtained on cooling to room temperature.
synthesis.temperature: 80 °C; cooled to room temperature for crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Yellow crystals obtained at room temperature after heating.

source_locations.location: Supplied CCDC catalog row for DOI

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A discrete doughnut-like Eu30 cluster composed of six Eu5 asymmetric units. The reported outer and inner diameters are approximately 3.0 and 0.4 nm, respectively, and its thickness is approximately 1.3 nm.

synthesis.procedure: Prepared by the Eu30 procedure, replacing Eu(NO3)3·6H2O with Dy(NO3)3·6H2O: 1,3,4-thiadiazole-2,5-diamine (116 mg, 0.2 mmol), 8-hydroxyquinoline-2-carbaldehyde (19 mg, 0.1 mmol), the lanthanide nitrate hexahydrate (0.2 mmol), and triethylamine (40 μL) were combined in 2 mL methanol/water (2:1 by volume) in a sealed Pyrex tube and heated at 80 °C for 72 h. The SI specifies substitution of the metal salt but does not separately state its mass.

reagents.name: dysprosium(III) nitrate hexahydrate
reagents.amount: 0.2 mmol per shared procedure; mass not separately reported

synthesis.temperature: 80 °C; cooled to room temperature for crystallization
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Sealed Pyrex tube; same procedure as Eu30 with metal-salt substitution
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Crystals obtained on cooling to room temperature, per shared procedure.

source_locations.location: Section 3, Structural determination of Eu30 and Dy30

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Reported as a structural analogue of the doughnut-like Eu30 cluster. The SI notes that crystal weathering prevented collection of high-quality Dy30 single-crystal data, although preliminary framework analysis indicated a similar structure.
